learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to make one thing into many things by adding a magical 's'!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we have only one thing, we call it one. Like one red apple or one cute cat. It stands all alone!
When we have more than one thing, we call it many. Like two apples or three cats. It is a big fun group!
We can change one into many by adding a magic 's' at the end. One car becomes two cars. One star becomes many stars!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Magic 'S' Hunt
fun_activity.instructions: Gather your favorite toys. Say 'toy' when you hold one, and shout 'toys' when you hold them all together!

quick_recap: ⭐ One means only a single thing.
⭐ Many means two or more things together.
⭐ Just add an 's' at the end of a word to make it many!
